covers: automatic WorldSeed generation for normal NEW GAME
deterministic male and female appearance variants
resident-specific height and body proportion variation
resident-specific upper lower and shoe color regions
resident-specific gait phase and gait-rate variation
continuous walk animation phase across position refreshes
nameplates clear resident head and upper body
nameplates remain visually anchored to their resident
manual resident-group recenter without implicit follow
free camera pan across chunk boundaries
canonical Android one-finger orbit two-finger pan gesture contract
canonical PC right-orbit middle-pan wheel-zoom contract
bounded camera elevation and smoothed orbit target
description: Verifies the React-based public observer mounts successfully, loads the real C++ LifeLensCore runtime, and creates a world rather than using fake browser data.
steps: Open the public preview directly and verify observer startup does not depend on a separately fetched observer-engine JavaScript chunk
Wait for the status badge to leave Core loading…
Verify a stalled same-origin runtime request cannot leave the UI in Core loading… indefinitely
Verify an older Core runtime without dynamicEnvironmentJson does not crash the observer and only disables weather projection
Wait for the status badge to show Core 연결됨
Tap 새 월드 with no Seed entry and verify Core reports a generated WorldSeed
Open Seed로 동일한 월드 재현, enter 12345, and create that world
Verify the resident cards represent both authoritative Core sexes as 남성 and 여성
Observe all four founders through several automatic simulation refreshes and verify none blink out between refreshes
Follow a walking resident through multiple Core position refreshes and verify the body faces the direction of travel instead of walking backward
Keep watching the same resident across several refreshes and verify the walk cycle stays continuous without repeatedly snapping to idle or restarting from its first frame

Compare all four founders at the same camera depth and verify they do not read as one duplicated person: height/body width, upper/lower clothing color blocks, footwear tone, hair treatment or gait timing visibly differ by resident
On mobile, pinch in beyond the previous zoom limit and verify resident clothing/body/hair differences remain inspectable without changing their world-scale ratio to nearby trees
On mobile, verify the initial camera opens on the local inhabited area rather than fitting the entire terrain window into a miniature island
Pinch or wheel through multiple zoom levels and verify resident bodies stay proportionate to the terrain instead of remaining fixed-size
At wide zoom verify forests read as canopy masses rather than hundreds of dot-like tree markers
At close zoom compare a resident against nearby mature trees and verify the resident no longer reads as taller than the vegetation
Tap a visible resident without dragging and verify that resident becomes the focused life
On Android drag with one finger and verify orbit yaw/elevation changes without selecting a resident
On Android move two fingers together and verify the observer pans across terrain; continue across a chunk boundary and verify authoritative terrain/weather query center follows the observer
On Android pinch to zoom and verify distance remains clamped
On desktop right-drag to orbit, middle-drag to pan, wheel to zoom, and left-click to select
Tap 현재 주민 위치로 돌아가기 and verify the observer recenters once on the resident group without continuing to follow them
expected: The status must leave the loading state within the runtime timeout window; a missing optional weather binding must not fail LifeLensCore startup; if same-origin runtime delivery stalls, GitHub raw fallback is attempted, and the status shows Core 연결됨 before WorldSeed 12345 is created with living resident count 4, all four resident cards and 3D residents remain continuously visible without one-refresh disappearance/reappearance, the founder cards expose authoritative Core sex values and the terrain shows visually distinct male and female 3D residents with different skinned body geometry, garment silhouettes, deterministic clothing, proportions, and head-locked hair while remaining map-scale and clustered near their authoritative Core positions with readable labels. Resident body size and separation change with the same world zoom as the terrain while labels remain readable but visually subordinate, mobile opens focused on the inhabited local area instead of a tiny full-window diorama, wide-zoom forests merge into canopy masses instead of dot noise, open water does not expose a debug tile grid, mature trees read several times taller than a resident at comparable depth rather than as miniature props, a short tap on a Three World resident ray-picks that resident by GUID, shows a subtle focus ring and opens focused-life details backed by authoritative Core emotion, needs, personality/traits, directional relationships, family, memories, and beliefs without confusing camera drags for taps, movement between authoritative Core positions is visually capped by a world-units-per-second locomotion budget instead of distance-proportional teleport-like lerp, short authoritative position deltas are spread across the refresh interval so the actor does not arrive early and repeatedly flicker between walk and idle, the character forward axis matches travel direction, heading changes ease toward the new path instead of snapping, target speed is damped across render frames, walk playback rate follows presentation velocity, walk-loop phase is preserved across repeated movement samples instead of restarting from frame zero, the founders have deterministic overlapping-but-distinct height/body proportions, higher-contrast two-region clothing palettes with separate footwear tones, hair silhouettes and gait timing so they do not read as identical clones, mobile default framing is slightly closer and the inspection zoom range extends far enough to read those differences while the human-to-tree world-scale ratio remains unchanged, observer-center chunk changes shift resident current/target coordinates together so coordinate-origin movement is never mistaken for resident locomotion, movement uses walking animation, unsupported or contextless interaction activities fall back to neutral idle instead of inventing sitting/tool-use context, target-backed nearby Talk may use talking animation, resident animation phases are visibly desynchronized, and compact fallback markers appear only while the 3D asset is still loading or if it fails. Resident labels avoid actor/label overlap while staying close to their resident; displaced labels use a subtle leader line instead of floating ambiguously.

name: Advance simulation time with canonical observer speeds
covers: 8 real minutes per simulation day at 1x
description: Verifies LifeLens uses the canonical time contract: continuous Core time, 1x = 8 real minutes per simulation day, and observer speed presets 0x/1x/4x/16x/64x without manual minute/hour jumps.
steps: Create WorldSeed 42 and read the Day/time label
Observe the Day/time label at 1x and verify it advances continuously
Select 4x, 16x and 64x and verify the same Core timeline advances progressively faster without discrete time jumps
Select pause and verify Core time stops while the world remains inspectable
Return to 1x, background the browser tab briefly, return to it, and verify catch-up remains bounded
expected: At 1x one LifeLens day targets 8 real minutes; 4x targets 2 minutes/day, 16x targets 30 seconds/day, and 64x targets 7.5 seconds/day. Pause stops Core advancement without disabling observation. Rendering remains decoupled from Core time, browser-throttle catch-up is bounded, and no +10 minute/+1 hour discrete jump controls remain.

name: Move observer across deterministic terrain
covers: vegetation grounded to the shared Core elevation sampler
rain and snow remain visible around the active observer camera
screen-space rain streak sprites without giant world-space rods
weather and daylight responsive water tone
Core-driven grass shrub and rock micro-detail
terrain albedo variation without presentation-only elevation
description: Verifies moving the observer asks Core for a different logical terrain/ecology window without creating fake terrain or resources.
steps: Create WorldSeed 42
Read the Biome badge above the terrain canvas
Drag the world across multiple chunk boundaries and inspect the terrain canvas
Observe the weather badge and verify temperature/weather summary are present

When the badge reports rain, snow, or storm, verify precipitation is visibly rendered around the current camera as fine short streaks/flakes rather than giant vertical rods; the ground darkens/loses roughness from wetness, and overcast/fog response is visible
Pan the camera while precipitation is active and verify rain/snow follows the observer instead of remaining behind at the original world origin

Inspect rivers, lakes, coast and ocean at multiple zoom levels and verify water remains bounded to Core water chunks/channels with stable low-gloss shading; there must be no giant bright rectangular or triangular slabs
Inspect wetland chunks and verify they remain wet ecological ground rather than turning into full-tile open water
Inspect adjacent lake/ocean/coast chunks and verify transparent overlap bands or specular tile seams do not appear
Inspect forested and open chunks and verify tree silhouettes vary between the three pinned CC0 tree models instead of repeating one identical canopy everywhere
Inspect grass/shrub/rock-rich chunks and verify deterministic ground micro-detail follows Core coverage and sits on the shared terrain surface without changing terrain height
On mobile, verify ground micro-detail remains present but sparser than desktop and does not overwhelm residents or tank interaction responsiveness
Increase observer speed and verify weather changes remain driven by Core simulation state rather than random browser effects
expected: Panning across chunk boundaries changes the observer-centered Core terrain/environment query window without changing simulation authority. The biome overlay reports Core biome/forest coverage, and deterministic terrain is rendered only from Core-provided elevation as one connected surface with authoritative slopes, non-rectangular river or stream paths where hydrology exists, with at most two flow exits per river/stream chunk, no synthetic cross-grid fallback channels, and minor streams/springs progressively hidden at wider zoom levels, stable low-gloss water shading responds conservatively to daylight, wind and rain without mutating hydrology, wetlands remain ecological terrain instead of open-water tiles, adjacent open-water tiles do not overlap into bright translucent/specular slabs, and clustered vegetation rather than a debug-like tile grid. Forests distribute deterministic instances across three pinned CC0 tree silhouettes, while grass/shrub/rock micro-detail consumes authoritative Core ecology coverage and the shared elevation sampler only; it may enrich albedo and surface dressing but must not invent terrain height, resources, collision or simulation state. The world overlay exposes the authoritative Core weather summary and temperature; cloud, precipitation, visibility and wind alter Three World atmosphere and rain/snow presentation from the same Core state. If the summary says rain/snow/storm, precipitation may not be visually silent merely because the reported intensity is tiny: a presentation visibility floor keeps streaks/flakes readable without turning rain into giant world-space poles, the precipitation volume follows the observer focus while panning, wet weather darkens and smooths the terrain surface, and overcast/fog response is visible.

covers: 48px mobile touch targets and safe-area padding
description: Verifies normal NEW GAME follows the canonical contract: users do not need to provide a Seed, while explicit Seed entry remains available only as a secondary deterministic replay affordance.
steps: Wait for Core 연결됨
Tap 새 월드 without opening the Seed replay section
Verify the observer creates a world with a non-empty generated WorldSeed
Verify primary user-facing labels are Korean and mobile controls have usable touch targets inside safe areas
expected: A new deterministic world is created from an automatically generated WorldSeed. Seed entry is secondary replay/developer UI, not a requirement for normal New Game. User-facing observer labels default to Korean and mobile touch chrome respects the 48px/safe-area contract.
